paper.title: Gaussian Process Optimization with Adaptive Sketching: Scalable and No Regret

settings.name_in_paper: Optimization under bandit feedback / kernelized bandits (frequentist, bounded RKHS norm)
unmapped: bounded kernel k(x,x) <= kappa^2 for all arms; the learner knows kappa
settings.definition_quote: we assume that $\armset \triangleq \{\bx_i\}_{i=1}^{\Narm}$ is a fixed finite set of $\Narm$ vectors in $\Real^d$. ... receives reward $y_t \triangleq f(\bx_t) + \eta_t$, where $\eta_t$ is a zero-mean noise ... $R_T \triangleq \sum_{t=1}^T f(\bx_\star) - f(\bx_t)$ ... we additionally assume that the reward function $f$ has a bounded norm ... $\normsmall{f}_{\rkhs} \leq F$

symbols.d_eff: effective dimension d_eff(lambda, X_T) = Tr(K_T(K_T+lambda I)^{-1}) of the arms selected by the algorithm (data-dependent)
symbols.sigma: noise standard deviation xi (Gaussian N(0, xi^2))

conditions: Gaussian noise N(0, xi^2) (paper notes extends to xi-sub-Gaussian)
tuning: beta_t = 2 xi sqrt(alpha log(kappa^2 t) sum_s sigma_tilde_t^2(x_s) + log(1/delta)) + (1 + 1/sqrt(1-eps)) sqrt(lambda) F

source.label: thm:main-regret
source.quote: Assume $\normsmall{f}_{\rkhs} \leq F < \infty$. For any desired $0 < \varepsilon < 1$, $0 < \delta < 1$, $0 < \lambda$, let $\alpha \triangleq (1 + \varepsilon)/(1 - \varepsilon)$ and $\qbar \geq 6\alpha\log(4T/\delta)/\varepsilon^2$. If we run \bkb with ... then, with probability of at least $1-\delta$, the regret $R_T$ of \bkb is bounded as R_T \leq 2(2\alpha)^{3/2}\sqrt{T}(...)

results.notes: Regret is defined via f values (pseudo-regret type) but holds w.h.p., so recorded as high_probability_regret. d_eff is data-dependent (on arms selected by BKB); paper notes d_eff <= logdet(K_T/lambda + I) so GP-UCB gamma_T bounds apply. Per-step runtime O(A d_eff^2). Theorem 1 (variance accuracy and dictionary size |S_t| <= 3(1+kappa^2/lambda) alpha qbar d_eff) is a computational guarantee, not recorded.
